paper text.text:
The paths $P_x,P_y,s_xps_y,t_xrt_y$ give $B\cup C$ as a
minor of $G$, so it has no $K_5$ minor. It is nonplanar by
Lemma~\ref{dis:four-cycles}, and every $K_{3,3}$ subdivision
in it uses $s_yt_y$, since
deleting this edge leaves the planar graph
$B\cup s_ys_xt_xt_y$.
Corollary~\ref{common:reduced-forms}, with $H_0=C$, therefore lists
the $1{,}378$ possible forms of $B$, with $s_yt_y$ required in the subdivision.
Up to interchanging $A_1,A_2$, the enumeration in~\supp{E6}
leaves only one form for which $B\cup K_4[A]$ is
three-connected, there are no disjoint $s_x$--$t_y$ and
$s_y$--$t_x$ paths, and no degree-three interior vertex has
adjacent neighbors in $G$. Its interior is $\{p',q',v\}$,
where
\[
N(p')=N(q')=\{s_x,s_y,v\},
\]
and its remaining edges are $vt_x,vt_y$.

B + C.meaning: B + s_x t_x + t_x t_y + t_y s_y + s_y s_x, the cycle completion B ∪ C

B + sy sx + sx tx + tx ty.meaning: B + s_y s_x + s_x t_x + t_x t_y, the path completion B ∪ s_y s_x t_x t_y

B + K4[sx,tx,sy,ty].meaning: B plus all six edges among s_x, t_x, s_y, t_y

B + sx tx + sy ty.meaning: B + s_x t_x + s_y t_y, a subgraph of G once P_x, P_y are edges

vertex names: the attachments s_x, t_x, s_y, t_y of B, written sx, tx, sy, ty; interior vertices of B are u0, u1, ...; for the bridges that pass, the paper's names are given with the verdict

excluded by a hypothesis of the case.fact: the path completion B + s_y s_x + s_x t_x + t_x t_y is nonplanar
excluded by a hypothesis of the case.why it excludes the bridge: The proof chooses the planar path completion: "Some path completion of B is planar, say B ∪ s_y s_x t_x t_y."

excluded by a hypothesis of the case.fact: B has disjoint s_x-t_y and s_y-t_x paths
excluded by a hypothesis of the case.why it excludes the bridge: The proof shows: "Also, B has no disjoint s_x–t_y and s_y–t_x paths."

excluded by a hypothesis of the case.fact: an interior vertex of degree three has two adjacent neighbours
excluded by a hypothesis of the case.why it excludes the bridge: Lemma 3.4(a); the edges added in the test graph are edges of G.

excluded by a hypothesis of the case.fact: B plus all edges among its four attachments has a cut of at most two vertices
excluded by a hypothesis of the case.why it excludes the bridge: Three-connectivity of B ∪ K_4[attachments], used with Construction 3.18.

verdicts.K5 minor: a K5 minor in the named graph, which is a minor of G
verdicts.proper nontoroidal minor: an allowed reduction of B (Section 3) after which the named test graph is still nonplanar; the proof shows that this gives a proper nontoroidal minor of G
verdicts.isomorphic to a bridge given in the text: B passes every test of the case and is isomorphic to a bridge given in the text (listed under "bridges given in the text"); the record that it passes the tests is kept with the verdict
